scenarios.name: MP-01 loading a named profile returns all its parameters

steps.text: the profile "gemma4-openrouter" is loaded
the returned parameters include base_url "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"
the returned parameters include model "google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it"
the returned parameters include api_key "sk-or-v1-xxx"
the returned parameters include max_completion_tokens 16384
the returned parameters include temperature 0.4

scenarios.name: MP-02 loading a profile with optional parameters top_p and top_k

steps.text: a profiles YAML file with the following profiles:
the profile "tuned" is loaded
the returned parameters include top_p 0.9
the returned parameters include top_k 40

scenarios.name: MP-03 loading a profile with custom headers

steps.text: a profiles YAML file with the following profiles:
the profile "with-hdr" is loaded
the returned parameters include headers with key "X-Custom" and value "value"
the returned parameters include headers with key "X-Region" and value "eu"

scenarios.name: MP-04 loading a profile without optional fields uses defaults

steps.text: the profile "gemma4-local" is loaded
the returned parameters do not include max_completion_tokens
the returned parameters include temperature 0.4

scenarios.name: MP-05 loading a profile from a custom profiles file path

steps.text: a profiles YAML file at a custom path with profile "custom-remote"
the profile "custom-remote" is loaded from the custom path
the returned parameters include model "custom-model"

scenarios.name: MP-06 missing profiles file raises a clear error

steps.text: no profiles file exists at the expected path
loading any profile
a clear error is raised mentioning the file path

scenarios.name: MP-07 unknown profile name raises a clear error

steps.text: the profile "nonexistent" is loaded
a clear error is raised mentioning the profile name "nonexistent"

scenarios.name: MP-08 profile missing a required field raises a clear error

steps.text: a profiles YAML file with the following profiles:
the profile "missing-url" is loaded
a clear error is raised mentioning "base_url"

scenarios.name: MP-09 runner script with --profile passes parameters to LLMClient

steps.text: the runner script is invoked with --profile "gemma4-openrouter"
the LLMClient is created with base_url "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"
the LLMClient is created with model "google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it"
the LLMClient is created with temperature 0.4

scenarios.name: MP-10 runner script without --profile falls back to environment variables

steps.text: environment variables SCENARIO_FORGE_MODEL_BASE_URL, SCENARIO_FORGE_API_KEY, and SCENARIO_FORGE_MODEL_NAME are set
the runner script is invoked without --profile
the LLMClient is created from environment variables
no profile name is recorded in the run manifest

scenarios.name: MP-11 profile name is recorded in the run manifest

steps.text: the runner script is invoked with --profile "sonnet-4"
the run manifest model_config dict contains key "profile" with value "sonnet-4"

scenarios.name: MP-12 runner script with --profiles-file uses the specified file

steps.text: a profiles YAML file at a custom path with profile "alt-model"
the runner script is invoked with --profiles-file <custom-path> and --profile "alt-model"
the LLMClient is created with model "alt-model"

scenarios.name: MP-13 LLMClient accepts top_p and top_k parameters

steps.text: an LLMClient is created with top_p 0.9 and top_k 40
the LLMClient stores top_p as 0.9
the LLMClient stores top_k as 40

scenarios.name: MP-14 LLMClient without top_p and top_k leaves them unset

steps.text: an LLMClient is created without top_p and top_k
the LLMClient top_p is None
the LLMClient top_k is None
